mLocKeys.keySummary: Mordekaiser curses an enemy, stealing a percent of their life initially and each second. If the target dies while the spell is active, their soul is enslaved and will follow Mordekaiser as a ghost for 30 seconds.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Mordekaiser steals @TotalDamage@% maximum Health magic damage.

If the target dies while cursed, their soul is enslaved and will follow Mordekaiser as a ghost for @GhostDuration@ seconds. Mordekaiser gains 20% of their Ability Power and Attack Damage, and the ghost's stats are enhanced.

mLocKeys.keySummary: A percent of the damage dealt from abilities is converted into a temporary shield, absorbing incoming damage.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Mordekaiser converts @SiphonValue*100@% of the damage dealt from his abilities into a temporary <shield>shield (up to @MaxShield@)</shield>. The shield decays by @DecayCalcForTooltip@ per second.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Unleashes a protective cloud of metal shards to surround an ally, increasing their armor and magic resistance and dealing damage per second to enemies in the cloud.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Unleashes a protective cloud of metal shards to surround an ally for @Duration@ seconds, giving them <scaleArmor>@DefenseStats@ armor</scaleArmor> and <scaleMR>@DefenseStats@ magic resistance</scaleMR> and dealing <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> over the duration to nearby enemies.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Mordekaiser curses an enemy, stealing a percent of their life initially and each second. If the target dies while the spell is active, their soul is enslaved and will follow Mordekaiser as a ghost for 30 seconds.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Commands the ghost to move to the target location or attack the target enemy.

The ghost will follow Mordekaiser for 30 seconds, and Mordekaiser gains 20% of its Ability Power and Attack Damage.

The ghost can also be controlled by holding the alt key and using the right mouse button.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Mordekaiser deals damage to enemies in a cone in front of him.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Mordekaiser damages enemies in a cone in front of him, dealing <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>.
